# Renamed and removed members (JavaScript)

[← Migrating to rhino3dm 9.2 (JavaScript)](javascript.md)

<!-- D19 -->

alongside RhinoCommon's API are not listed, nor are members only 8.x Python had. Search this
page for the name your script uses.
